components.css: .ds-faq{font-family:var(--font-sans);color:var(--color-fg);border-block:1px solid var(--color-rule)}.ds-faq summary{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:1.5rem;list-style:none;cursor:pointer;padding-block:1.375rem;font-size:.9375rem;font-weight:500}.ds-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-faq summary:hover{color:var(--color-primary)}.ds-faq summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--color-primary);outline-offset:5px}.ds-faq[open] summary>svg{rotate:180deg}.ds-faq p{max-width:65ch;padding:0 2rem 1.5rem 0;color:var(--color-muted);font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.9}

narrative.overview: A professional, modern and calm world with open space, confident sans-serif typography and gently tinted surfaces. Dynamism comes from scale, contrasting grounds and useful state changes. Flat surfaces, fine rules and restrained corners support an attentive visual voice.
keyCharacteristics: Lilac and mint grounds with blue-grey ink
Functional motion and visible keyboard states

rules.name: The Ground-and-Ink Rule
rules.body: Keep prose on contrasting grounds and retain the filled teal primary action.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Use Manrope; establish hierarchy through scale, weight, spacing and contrast.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Separate regions through ground, spacing and rules before adding elevation.

dos: Do reuse the normative frontmatter and source stylesheet.
Do preserve keyboard behavior and focus.
donts: Do not substitute an unrelated display family.
Do not add routine shadows or hover lifts to existing flat components.
Do not turn homepage composition into a global template.
